title: A novel radiomics approach for predicting TACE outcomes in hepatocellular carcinoma patients using deep learning for multi-organ segmentation.
summary: original PDF confirms pretrained DL segmentation enabled multi-organ radiomics and survival modeling after TACE in 252 patients; retrospective associations and stated need for external/prospective validation retained.
ai_technology: Pretrained deep-learning segmentation identifies multiple organs on CT for radiomics-based prediction of outcomes after transarterial chemoembolization in hepatocellular carcinoma.

evidence.tested: In 252 patients, the pipeline combined multi-organ segmentation with radiomics and survival modeling to estimate TACE outcomes.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective associations require external and prospective validation; no treatment benefit is established.
evidence.ai_role: Pretrained deep-learning segmentation identifies multiple organs on CT for radiomics-based prediction of outcomes after transarterial chemoembolization in hepatocellular carcinoma.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
